issues: Seventeenth-century gender-coded marital concord models do not establish actual present couples' psychological health, conduct, fidelity or longevity.

Claims about jealousy, infidelity, desire for other partners or behavior in a spouse are period stereotypes, never established actual psychological/moral facts.
Common versus movable signs are original zodiac taxonomy and interact with benefit/affliction conditions; avoid post-hoc rule selection.
